# O(1) country-scope scripted triggers for Byzantine Pillars, Civil Wars & Romanization/Union 2.0.

oe_bp2_is_byz_host = {
	tag = BYZ
	is_rebel_country = no
}

oe_bp2_is_imperial_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
	}
}

oe_bp2_pillars_live = {
	oe_bp2_is_byz_host = yes
	exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
}

oe_bp2_any_active_house = {
	oe_bp2_active_house_count >= 1
}

oe_bp2_two_active_houses = {
	oe_bp2_active_house_count >= 2
}

oe_bp2_has_consort_bond = {
	has_ruler = yes
	OR = {
		ruler = { is_married = yes }
		has_consort = yes
	}
}

oe_bp2_pillar_imbalanced = {
	oe_bp2_pillars_live = yes
	OR = {
		oe_bp2_authority_now < 25
		oe_bp2_opinion_now < 30
	}
}

oe_bp2_union_active = {
	has_variable = oe_un_st
	var:oe_un_st >= 2
	var:oe_un_st <= 3
}

oe_bp2_union_not_active = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_st }
		var:oe_un_st ?= 0
		var:oe_un_st ?= 4
	}
}

oe_bp2_rus_orthodox_neighbor_exists = {
	OR = {
		country_exists = c:MOS
		country_exists = c:RUS
		country_exists = c:NOV
	}
}

oe_bp2_rus_autocephaly_proclaimed = {
	OR = {
		AND = { country_exists = c:MOS c:MOS = { var:oe_rpl_ecc_stance ?= 2 } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { var:oe_rpl_ecc_stance ?= 2 } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:NOV c:NOV = { var:oe_rpl_ecc_stance ?= 2 } }
	}
}

oe_bp2_zealots_reckoning_ready = {
	oe_bp2_is_byz_host = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_15 }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
	current_year >= 1345
